name: Noise rotate in the model noise coordinate (GTE)
plain: Branches a partly sampled latent by rotating its implied noise by an angle, then rebuilding the state via the model's own scaling. Valid for flow and additive model types alike, since it recovers eps through a probe of noise_scaling.
math:
S,G = probe(noise_scaling) gives x=S+G·ε.
ε = (process_in(x) − S)/G; ε' = rotate(ε, θ, spread, count, seed).
x' = process_out(noise_scaling(σ, ε', x0)).

claims.text: Docstring reports a measured x0 component of 1.00 vs 0.125 valid at θ=90 under additive rotation of a flow model
